exposure: tumor volume to head circumference ratio (THC)
cohort: The study included eleven fetuses diagnosed with Sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) out of 15 identified in a referral teaching hospital between 2013 and 2023.
finding: A novel index, combining tumor volume to head circumference ratio (THC) and the presence of polyhydramnios, with a cutoff value higher than 3.0, was associated with postnatal mortality with 100% sensitivity and 86% specificity.
gest_age: Median gestational age at prenatal diagnosis was 30.9 weeks and median gestational age at birth was 35.8 weeks.
